name: Beto
bio: Railway signalman. Talks as if every word cost money.
rescueLines: Beto here. Thought nobody was listening.

habits.text: Checks his wristwatch every few minutes. It stopped years ago.
Sorts the bunker's chores into a strict schedule.
Whistles the 2:55 departure signal when he's happy.

name: Lucho
bio: Seventeen. Survived alone in a gated community. Won't say how.
rescueLines: Wait, there's really a bunker? With food?
Ok. I'm coming. But don't ask me about my mom.

habits.text: Pretends he isn't hungry. Always is.

name: Nilda
bio: Retired nurse. Worked at the hospital to the very last day. Calls everyone "dear".
rescueLines: Oh, dear. I thought nobody was coming.
Take me with you. And someone brew me a mate.

habits.text: Knits with whatever thread she finds.
Checks everyone's forehead for fever, uninvited.
Keeps a list of birthdays. Including yours, somehow.

name: La Rusa
bio: Truck driver. Crossed the country three times after the Silence. Won't give her real name.
rescueLines: All right, boss. You talked me into it. But I'm driving.
A bunker, they told me. We'll see.

habits.text: Sits with her back to the wall. Always.
Draws road maps on any flat surface.
Sings old truck-stop songs off key at night.
